description: This PHP source file defines the CurlFactory class responsible for creating, managing, and finalizing cURL handles within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes methods for configuring cURL options, handling request execution, error handling, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: A class that creates and manages cURL resources for HTTP requests, including configuration, execution, error handling, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new EasyHandle for a given request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a handle back to the pool or closes it if the pool is full.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cURL transaction, returning a fulfilled or rejected promise based on the response or error.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.

methods.name: finishError
methods.description: Handles errors during request execution, creating appropriate rejection promises.

methods.name: createRejection
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise based on cURL error context.

methods.name: getDefaultConf
methods.description: Generates default cURL configuration options based on the request.

methods.name: applyMethod
methods.description: Configures cURL options based on the HTTP method and request body.

methods.name: applyBody
methods.description: Configures cURL options for sending the request body.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers for the cURL request.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a specific header from the options array.

methods.name: applyHandlerOptions
methods.description: Applies additional handler options such as SSL verification, proxy, and debug settings.

methods.name: retryFailedRewind
methods.description: Retries the request if the body rewind fails, with a limit on retries.

methods.name: createHeaderFn
methods.description: Creates a callback function to process response headers during cURL execution.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up all handles by closing them when the object is destroyed.
